title: Cross-Functional Announcement Sprint: Ownership Matrix and Emergency Fallback Plan
creator: Amina Patel
description: Create a coordinated sprint plan and ops playbook that aligns blog, email, social, webinar, and docs release for Adaptive-Routing GA. Deliverables: channel owner matrix, decision gates for copy/code freeze, release notes canonical source, and an emergency fallback plan for partial rollouts or infra incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Channel ownership matrix agreed and signed off by each channel owner
Canonical release notes doc created and linked in release repo
Announcement assets (blog draft, email copy, social tiles) have owners and deadlines in calendar
Webinar content outline and host identified; rehearsal scheduled 3 days before GA
Fallback plan tested via tabletop exercise with ops and comms leads

risks_and_mitigations: Risk: Last-minute infra degradation during staged rollout. Mitigation: Pre-rollout health checks and automatic rollback to previous model variant; ops on-call paged at first error spike.
Risk: Legal compliance hold on marketing copy. Mitigation: Early legal review by 2026-03-11; marketing freeze gate on 2026-03-14.
Risk: Webinar speaker cancellation. Mitigation: Backup speaker roster + prerecorded short demo available.
Risk: Mismatched release notes between docs and blog. Mitigation: Single source-of-truth doc (canonical release notes) and sign-off workflow.
